title: Integer overflow on 32-bit in UDP length calculation
description:
**File:** rust/lichen-ipv6/src/lib.rs
**Lines:** 451, 487

**Issue:**
`UDP_HEADER_LEN + payload.len()` can wrap on 32-bit platforms when payload.len() is near usize::MAX.

```rust
let total = UDP_HEADER_LEN + payload.len();  // line 451, 487
if total > u16::MAX as usize { ... }
```

On 32-bit: 8 + 0xFFFFFFF8 = 0 (wraps). The subsequent check `0 > 65535` is false, so an invalid length passes validation.

**Trigger:** 32-bit embedded target with maliciously large payload slice (theoretical - requires attacker control of slice length).

**Fix:** Use `payload.len().checked_add(UDP_HEADER_LEN).filter(|&t| t <= u16::MAX as usize).ok_or(...)` or validate payload.len() first.
close_reason: Fixed: use checked_add for UDP length calculations to prevent overflow on 32-bit
